notes: Posted 30 July 2001 with no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'At The Start...': Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers, '[Indicator]', Rendezvous Point, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice, Insurrection and Your Insight Serves You Well; these count toward the 60.
Posted '[Indicator]' is the planet system Hidden Base places face down to mark the hidden base; the post does not name it, so it is printed as written (type UNKNOWN) and counted.
The section headers 'At The Start...', 'Locations...', 'Grey...', 'White...', 'Blue...', 'Red...' and 'Green...' were mis-parsed as cards in the draft and are dropped.
Posted 'WA/DODN' dested the Light combo Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'Redevous Point' Rendezvous Point; 'Hoth DB' Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (the strategy deploys it with Insurrection).
Posted 'Endor' dested the Light Endor system; 'Kiffex' dested the Light Jabba's Palace Kiffex (the plain page is Dark).

Posted 'Qui-Gon "I'm Your Mama" Jinn' dested Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine); 'Jedi Luke' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Naked Threepio' Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Artoo' dested the Light Jabba's Palace Artoo (the strategy pulls him with Seeking An Audience); 'Lando in Falcon' Lando In Millennium Falcon.
